lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: Hi! Good morning. What's your name?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: My name is Tom. And you?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: I'm Ana. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Nice to meet you, Ana. How are you?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: Very well, thanks. Where are you from?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: Soy de Inglaterra. Hablo un poco de español.
lines.english: I'm from England. I speak a little Spanish.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: Of course! You speak very well.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: No, no entiendo. Más despacio, por favor.
lines.english: No, I don't understand. Slower, please.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: No worries. Slower.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Thanks, Ana. Sorry, what does "despacio" mean?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: "Despacio" is "slowly". See you tomorrow, Tom!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: Buenas tardes. Un momento, por favor.
lines.english: Good afternoon. One moment, please.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.english: Hi! I'm Luis. What do you want?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: Quisiera el café con leche, por favor.
lines.english: I'd like the coffee with milk, please.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.english: With ice?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: No, sin hielo. Y la tortilla, ¿está rica?
lines.english: No, without ice. And the tortilla, is it good?

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.target: ¡Sí, claro! Está caliente y muy rica.
lines.english: Yes, of course! It's hot and very good.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: Para mí, la tortilla con pan.
lines.english: For me, the tortilla with bread.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.english: Anything else? Water, juice?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Nothing else, thanks. I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.english: Enjoy your meal, Tom!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: How good! The bill, please.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Excuse me, how much does the coffee cost?

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.english: It costs three euros.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Three euros! That is very expensive.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.english: All right, two euros fifty.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: And the tortilla? How much is it?

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.target: La tortilla, cuatro euros. Total: seis cincuenta.
lines.english: The tortilla, four euros. Total: six fifty.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Very well. Do you take cards?

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.target: Lo siento, no. En efectivo, por favor.
lines.english: Sorry, no. In cash, please.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: No pasa nada. Tengo veinte euros.
lines.english: No worries. I have twenty euros.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.target: Gracias. Aquí está el cambio y el recibo.
lines.english: Thanks. Here is your change and the receipt.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Do you charge a tip? I don't know.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.english: No, it's fine. See you later!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Excuse me, I'm lost. Can you help me?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: Yes, of course. What do you need?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: Quiero llegar a la estación. ¿Está lejos?
lines.english: I want to get to the station. Is it far?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.target: No, está cerca. Todo derecho, a la plaza.
lines.english: No, it's near. Straight ahead, to the square.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: And at the square?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.target: Doblar a la izquierda. La estación está en la esquina.
lines.english: Turn left. The station is on the corner.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: How long does it take on foot?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.target: Quince minutos. ¿Quieres el autobús? Sale aquí.
lines.english: Fifteen minutes. Do you want the bus? It leaves here.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: No, a pie. Necesito el mapa, por favor.
lines.english: No, on foot. I need the map, please.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.target: ¡Cuidado con la calle! Y buen viaje.
lines.english: Careful on the street! And have a good trip.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Thanks, Ana. Bye!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Ana, I'm tired. I'm sleepy.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: What do you need? Do you want coffee?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: I don't want anything. I need to sleep.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.target: ¡Es verdad! Tienes prisa y no tienes tiempo.
lines.english: It's true! You're in a hurry and you don't have time.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.target: Tengo un problema: el hotel está lejos.
lines.english: I have a problem: the hotel is far.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: Do you want a taxi? It is here.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Yes, please. How much does it cost?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: I want to pay. May I?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Of course! Thanks, Ana.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: Fine. Are you ready?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.english: Yes, I am ready. Thanks, Ana!

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.english: You're welcome. See you tomorrow, Tom!
